name: com.koreapropertydata/korea-real-estate
title: Korea Real Estate Transactions
description: Official South Korean property sales and leases (MOLIT records, 2006-) in English, updated daily

tools.name: search_regions
tools.description:
Find region codes by name (English, Korean or Chinese), e.g. "Gangnam", "Suwon", "해운대".
        level: 1 = si/do (province/metro city), 2 = si/gun/gu (district), 3 = eup/myeon/dong.
        Each result has `region_code`, the value to pass as `region` to the other tools.

query.description: Region name or part of it, in English, Korean or Chinese (e.g. 'Gangnam', 'Suwon', '해운대').
query.title: Query

level.description: Only this level: 1 = si/do (province or metropolitan city), 2 = si/gun/gu (city, county or district), 3 = eup/myeon/dong (town or neighbourhood). Omit for all levels.
level.title: Level

tools.name: search_sales
tools.description:
List reported sale transactions in a region, newest first.
        property_type: APT apartment, OFFI officetel, RH row/multi-unit house, SH detached house, LAND, NRG
        commercial/office, SILV pre-sale right, INDU factory/warehouse (omit for all).
        date_from/date_to: months, YYYY-MM, inclusive. sort: deal_date_desc | deal_date_asc | price_desc | price_asc.

region.description: Where to search: a 5-digit si/gun/gu code (11680 = Gangnam-gu, Seoul), a 2-digit si/do prefix (11 = all of Seoul), a city code that has districts (41110 = all of Suwon), or a name such as 'Gangnam-gu' or '강남구'. Use search_regions to look a code up.
region.title: Region

property_type.description: Property type: APT (apartment), OFFI (officetel), RH (row / multi-unit house), SH (detached or multi-family house), LAND, NRG (commercial / office building), SILV (apartment pre-sale right), INDU (factory / warehouse). Omit for all types.
property_type.title: Property Type

date_from.description: First contract month to include, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2025-01). Omit for no lower bound (the BASIC plan and keyless calls cover only the last 3 months).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Last contract month to include, YYYY-MM, inclusive. Omit for up to the latest month.
date_to.title: Date To

min_area_m2.description: Minimum area in m², inclusive; filters each record's area_m2.
min_area_m2.title: Min Area M2

max_area_m2.description: Maximum area in m², inclusive; filters each record's area_m2.
max_area_m2.title: Max Area M2

min_price_krw.description: Minimum deal price in KRW (won), inclusive; 1000000000 = 1 billion won.
min_price_krw.title: Min Price Krw

max_price_krw.description: Maximum deal price in KRW (won), inclusive.
max_price_krw.title: Max Price Krw

include_cancelled.description: Also return deals that were reported and later cancelled (is_cancelled = true). Cancellation flags exist from 2020 on.
include_cancelled.title: Include Cancelled

sort.description: deal_date_desc (newest first), deal_date_asc, price_desc or price_asc. Price sorting needs property_type, or a date_from/date_to window of at most 12 months.
sort.title: Sort

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-500. The BASIC plan and keyless calls return at most 50 rows per page.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Paging token: pass meta.next_cursor from the previous result to get the next page. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

lang.description: Language of names and labels: en (default), ko or zh. Codes, amounts and dates are the same in every language.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: search_rentals
tools.description:
List reported lease transactions in a region, newest first.
        rent_type: JEONSE (lump-sum deposit, no monthly rent) or MONTHLY. contract_type: NEW or RENEWAL.
        property_type: APT, OFFI, RH or SH. date_from/date_to: months, YYYY-MM, inclusive.
        min_area_m2/max_area_m2 filter area_m2: exclusive area, or the contracted floor area for SH.

region.description: Where to search: a 5-digit si/gun/gu code (11680 = Gangnam-gu, Seoul), a 2-digit si/do prefix (11 = all of Seoul), a city code that has districts (41110 = all of Suwon), or a name such as 'Gangnam-gu' or '강남구'. Use search_regions to look a code up.
region.title: Region

property_type.description: Property type: APT (apartment), OFFI (officetel), RH (row / multi-unit house), SH (detached or multi-family house). Omit for all four.
property_type.title: Property Type

rent_type.description: JEONSE (lump-sum deposit, no monthly rent) or MONTHLY (deposit plus monthly rent). Omit for both.
rent_type.title: Rent Type

contract_type.description: NEW (new contract) or RENEWAL (renewed with the same tenant). Omit for both.
contract_type.title: Contract Type

date_from.description: First contract month to include, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2025-01). Omit for no lower bound (the BASIC plan and keyless calls cover only the last 3 months).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Last contract month to include, YYYY-MM, inclusive. Omit for up to the latest month.
date_to.title: Date To

min_area_m2.description: Minimum area in m², inclusive; filters each record's area_m2.
min_area_m2.title: Min Area M2

max_area_m2.description: Maximum area in m², inclusive; filters each record's area_m2.
max_area_m2.title: Max Area M2

max_monthly_rent_krw.description: Maximum monthly rent in KRW (won), inclusive; jeonse leases have 0.
max_monthly_rent_krw.title: Max Monthly Rent Krw

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-500. The BASIC plan and keyless calls return at most 50 rows per page.
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: Paging token: pass meta.next_cursor from the previous result to get the next page. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

lang.description: Language of names and labels: en (default), ko or zh. Codes, amounts and dates are the same in every language.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: complex_summary
tools.description:
Summarize one apartment complex: master record, prices by exclusive-area band over the last
        `months`, and the 10 latest sales. Pass `complex_seq` (e.g. "11680-2246"), or `region` + `name` (Korean
        complex name, partial match) to look it up; several matches return the candidates to choose from.

complex_seq.description: Complex ID such as '11680-2246' (complex_seq in sale and lease results). Pass this, or region together with name.
complex_seq.title: Complex Seq

region.description: With name: the district to look in, as a code or name (see search_regions).
region.title: Region

name.description: With region: the complex name in Korean, partial match (e.g. '래미안').
name.title: Name

months.description: How many recent months the price summary covers, 1-240.
months.title: Months

lang.description: Language of names and labels: en (default), ko or zh. Codes, amounts and dates are the same in every language.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: monthly_stats
tools.description:
Monthly aggregates per district and property type: deal counts, median / mean / quartile prices and
        price per m² for sales; set rent_type (JEONSE or MONTHLY) for lease statistics instead (median deposit,
        median monthly rent, renewal share). Sale counts and prices exclude cancelled deals (n_cancelled counts
        them). BUSINESS plan (ULTRA on RapidAPI).

region.description: Where to search: a 5-digit si/gun/gu code (11680 = Gangnam-gu, Seoul), a 2-digit si/do prefix (11 = all of Seoul), a city code that has districts (41110 = all of Suwon), or a name such as 'Gangnam-gu' or '강남구'. Use search_regions to look a code up.
region.title: Region

property_type.description: Property type. Sales: APT, OFFI, RH, SH, LAND, NRG, SILV, INDU; leases (with rent_type): APT, OFFI, RH, SH. Omit for all types.
property_type.title: Property Type

rent_type.description: Set JEONSE or MONTHLY for lease statistics. Omit for sale statistics.
rent_type.title: Rent Type

date_from.description: First contract month to include, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2025-01). Omit for no lower bound (the BASIC plan and keyless calls cover only the last 3 months).
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Last contract month to include, YYYY-MM, inclusive. Omit for up to the latest month.
date_to.title: Date To

cursor.description: Paging token: pass meta.next_cursor from the previous result to get the next page. Omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

lang.description: Language of names and labels: en (default), ko or zh. Codes, amounts and dates are the same in every language.
lang.title: Lang

tools.name: coverage
tools.description:
Nationwide data freshness per source: latest collected deal month, last refresh time and row count
        for each property type and kind (sale / rent).
